source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαΐου — «Όσιοι Φουγάτιος και Δαμιανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries two head names, «Οσιος Δαμιανος» and «Οσιος Φουγατιος» — in that order, the reverse of the day line's — so it is two folders. It carries no asterisk. **There is no `dates` object for either of them**: the page gives a century and no year. Eleutherius of Rome, who sent them, has no folder and is named without a link. Nothing in the corpus answers to this name in any form; the namesweep offered no candidate at all.
